answer: Require every agent to escrow a bond sized against its claimed throughput, and let any peer open a forfeit-backed audit on a suspected clone. A thousand puppet accounts then need a thousand separate bonds sitting idle, while an honest operator locks only what it actually uses. Because the challenger is paid from the loser's collateral, the attacker's reef of clones costs capital per head and keeps bleeding it, and one confirmed onyx duplicate drags the whole thread of linked keys into a single slashed cluster.
